section: Can I update my date of birth through Update Aadhaar online Service?
text:
### Can I update my date of birth through Update Aadhaar online Service?
![](https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/static/media/ArrowDown.a5229ab197c918ede75c7ae811502301.svg)
No, to update Date of Birth (DoB) kindly visit nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra with DoB proof document.
![](https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/static/media/ArrowDown.a5229ab197c918ede75c7ae811502301.svg)
No. You can update your Date of Birth (DoB) only once. Further Date of Birth (DoB) can be changed under exceptional circumstances, kindly call 1947 in this regard.
